items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: Oral histories, hundreds of them, with Kareem Abdul-Jabbar or Bobby Short or Roy Haynes...

ctx.x: So to put it all together, so I was teaching at Manhattan, doing the Sirius Satellite Radio show, Juilliard was just about to start a jazz program, and I was going to teach there. And in 1997 I became Bobby Short’s musical director. So Bobby had had a trio for many, many years, famously, at the Café Carlyle. And we were in the wings once at Jazz at Lincoln Center on the benefit concert, we were both appearing. And I jokingly said, because I knew him through a woman named Jean Bach, and they were very good…

jokingly, I said like, “Hey man” I said, “you know, you know what you need, you need a big band.” I said, like I did for, you know, like I said, joking, a big band with Bobby Short. Well I got a phone call from him about six months later saying, “You know you mentioned a band and you know, I can’t afford a big band.” I said, “I was just joking, Bobby, Jesus, you know.” He said, “Well I’ll tell you what, I have one gig” at some hotel, not the Carlyle but like a one night off gig, and I have some charts, and I’ve…
